description: This file defines the SyncWorker class, a background worker for synchronizing notes in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It manages periodic synchronization tasks, handles network constraints, and provides methods to register or deregister the worker.

classes.name: SyncWorker
classes.description: A Worker subclass that performs background synchronization of notes, managing concurrent account syncs and network constraints.

methods.name: SyncWorker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SyncWorker with application context and worker parameters.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs the synchronization task by fetching accounts, initiating syncs, and waiting for completion.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Sets up or disables periodic synchronization work based on the backgroundSync flag.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Cancels any existing scheduled sync work with the specific tag.
